title: Key Beliefs: Sunni and Shi'a Islam

flashcard_questions.q: The largest branch of Islam, making up around 80–90% of Muslims worldwide, who follow the Sunnah and accept the four Rightly Guided Caliphs.
The second largest branch of Islam, making up around 10–20% of Muslims, who believe Ali and his descendants were the rightful successors of Muhammad.
A successor or leader of the Muslim community after the death of the Prophet Muhammad.

flashcard_questions.a: The Arabic term for faith or belief, referring to the six core beliefs that Sunni Muslims hold.
The teachings, actions and sayings of the Prophet Muhammad, used as a model for how Muslims should live.
